scope: Exact ALS registrar/CMake deltas composed over held startup afterimages, then own timer edits; parent families untouched

ALSCMakeEdits.new:
# Experimental native ALS: no JS stack emulation or new host imports.
option(NODE_COMPAT_ASYNC_LOCAL_STORAGE "Enable experimental native AsyncLocalStorage" OFF)
if(NODE_COMPAT_ASYNC_LOCAL_STORAGE AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    if(NOT TARGET builtin_node_compat OR NOT NODE_COMPAT_INTERNAL_TICKS OR NOT NODE_COMPAT_STRICT_INITIALIZATION)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Native ALS requires Node compatibility and private tick checkpoints")
    endif()
    if(ENABLE_JS_DEBUGGER)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Native ALS does not share its allocation metadata builder with Debugger")
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(extension_api INTERFACE NODE_COMPAT_ASYNC_LOCAL_STORAGE=1)
    target_include_directories(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime)
endif()
